t2.title: Plastic packaging be completely banned
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should plastic packaging be completely banned?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Plastic packaging has become a major environmental concern. While a complete ban may seem extreme, I believe it is necessary for our planet's future.

Firstly, plastic pollution is devastating our oceans and wildlife. Millions of tonnes of plastic enter the sea each year, killing marine animals and entering our food chain. A ban would dramatically reduce this pollution.

Secondly, sustainable alternatives already exist. Biodegradable packaging made from plant materials, paper, and glass can replace most plastic uses. Countries like Kenya have successfully implemented plastic bag bans, proving change is possible.

However, critics argue that banning plastic would increase costs and affect businesses. Nevertheless, the long-term environmental benefits outweigh short-term economic challenges. Moreover, green industries would create new job opportunities.

Furthermore, gradual implementation with government support could help businesses transition smoothly to eco-friendly alternatives.

In conclusion, banning plastic packaging is essential to protect our environment for future generations. We must act now before the damage becomes irreversible.

Hi!
I buy table. Table good.
Plastic bad. No plastic.
Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I bought a chair from your shop. The chair is okay, but there was a lot of plastic. I don't like plastic because it is bad for the animals. I think we should use less plastic. It is better for the world. Maybe use paper? Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear HomeStyle Furniture Customer Care,

I recently bought some furniture from your website and wanted to share my thoughts. The delivery was fine, and the furniture looks like the pictures. However, I think you use too much plastic packaging.

In my opinion, plastic is bad for the environment. For example, it pollutes the ocean and hurts animals. I think it would be better if you used less plastic and more paper or cardboard. Also, maybe you could offer customers a discount if they return the plastic for recycling.

Thank you for considering my feedback.

Sincerely,
A Satisfied Customer
t2.sampleB2: Should Plastic Packaging Be Completely Banned? Take a look inside any shopping bag and you'll find it: plastic, plastic and more plastic. But should we get rid of it altogether? In my view, a complete ban would do more good than harm. The main problem is pollution. Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in our oceans, where it harms wildlife and slowly breaks down into tiny particles that reach our food chain. Banning plastic packaging would help tackle this crisis at its source. On top of that, there are plenty of alternatives out there. Paper, glass and biodegradable materials can easily do the job, and switching to them would push companies to rethink how they package their products. Of course, a ban would not be plain sailing. Businesses might face higher costs, and some goods really do need protection in transit. However, with proper government support, these problems could be sorted out over time. All things considered, banning plastic packaging is a bold but necessary step. If we want to protect the planet for future generations, we simply cannot afford to wait.
t2.uzSample:
Plastik qadoqlash jiddiy ekologik muammoga aylandi. To'liq taqiq o'ta keskin choradek tuyulishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, menimcha, bu sayyoramiz kelajagi uchun zarur.

Birinchidan, plastik ifloslanish okeanlarimiz va yovvoyi tabiatimizga halokatli ta'sir ko'rsatmoqda. Har yili millionlab tonna plastik dengizga tushib, dengiz hayvonlarini o'ldirmoqda va oziq-ovqat zanjirimizga kirib bormoqda. Taqiq bu ifloslanishni keskin kamaytiradi.

Ikkinchidan, barqaror muqobillar allaqachon mavjud. O'simlik materiallari, qog'oz va shishadan tayyorlangan biologik parchalanadigan qadoqlash plastikdan foydalanishning aksariyat o'rnini bosishi mumkin. Keniya kabi davlatlar plastik paketlar taqiqini muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirib, o'zgarish mumkinligini isbotladi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar plastikni taqiqlash xarajatlarni oshiradi va biznesga ta'sir qiladi, deb ta'kidlashadi. Shunga qaramay, uzoq muddatli ekologik foydalar qisqa muddatli iqtisodiy qiyinchiliklardan ustun turadi. Bundan tashqari, yashil sanoat yangi ish o'rinlarini yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, hukumatning qo'llab-quvvatlashi bilan bosqichma-bosqich amalga oshirish biznesga ekologik toza muqobillarga silliq o'tishga yordam berishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, plastik qadoqlashni taqiqlash kelajak avlodlar uchun atrof-muhitimizni himoya qilish uchun zarurdir. Zarar qaytarilmas bo'lishidan oldin hozir harakat qilishimiz kerak.

Salom!
Men stol sotib olaman. Stol yaxshi.
Plastmassa yomon. Plastmassa yo'q.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Men sizning do'koningizdan stul sotib oldim. Stul yaxshi, lekin plastik juda ko'p edi. Menga plastik yoqmaydi, chunki u hayvonlar uchun yomon. O'ylaymanki, biz plastikdan kamroq foydalanishimiz kerak. Bu dunyo uchun yaxshiroq. Balki qog'ozdan foydalanish kerakdir? Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli HomeStyle Furniture mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish bo'limi,

Yaqinda sizning veb-saytingizdan bir nechta mebel sotib oldim va o'z fikrlarimni baham ko'rmoqchiman. Yetkazib berish yaxshi bo'ldi va mebel rasmlardagidek ko'rinadi. Biroq, menimcha, siz juda ko'p plastik qadoqlardan foydalanasiz.

Mening fikrimcha, plastik atrof-muhit uchun yomon. Misol uchun, u okeanni ifloslantiradi va hayvonlarga zarar yetkazadi. Agar siz kamroq plastik va ko'proq qog'oz yoki kartondan foydalansangiz, yaxshiroq bo'lardi deb o'ylayman. Shuningdek, agar mijozlar plastikni qayta ishlash uchun qaytarib bersalar, ularga chegirma taklif qilishingiz mumkin.

Fikrimni inobatga olganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Qoniqish hosil qilgan mijoz
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli HomeStyle Mebel Mijozlarga Xizmat Ko'rsatish Bo'limi,

Men yaqinda qilgan xaridim va, xususan, plastik qadoqlash masalasi bo'yicha fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Mebelning o'zi menga yoqdi, lekin uning qadoqlanishida haddan tashqari ko'p plastik ishlatilganidan hayratda qoldim.

Menimcha, plastik qadoqlashni butunlay taqiqlashni jiddiy ko'rib chiqish kerak. Plastikning atrof-muhitimizga salbiy ta'siri yaxshi hujjatlashtirilgan, to'lib-toshgan chiqindi poligonlaridan tortib dengiz ekotizimlariga halokatli ta'sirigacha. Plastik tashish paytida ma'lum himoya afzalliklarini taqdim etishini tushunsam ham, uzoq muddatli oqibatlar bu afzalliklardan ancha ustundir.

Biotexnik parchalanadigan qadoqlash yoki qayta ishlangan karton kabi muqobil variantlar mavjud va tobora tejamkor bo'lib bormoqda. Bundan tashqari, HomeStyle qaytarib olish dasturini amalga oshirishi mumkin, bu mijozlarni qadoqlashni qayta foydalanish yoki to'g'ri qayta ishlash uchun qaytarishga undaydi. Bu nafaqat chiqindilarni kamaytiradi, balki kompaniyangizning atrof-muhitga mas'uliyatli biznes sifatidagi imidjini ham oshiradi.

Sizni barqaror qadoqlash variantlariga ustuvor ahamiyat berishga va atrof-muhitga ongli kelajakka hissa qo'shishga chaqiraman.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirli Mijoz

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is moving to a new apartment. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I heard you're moving into your new place soon – how exciting! When I needed furniture, I found this great online store called HomeStyle. Their prices are really reasonable and the quality is surprisingly good. You should definitely check it out before buying elsewhere. Good luck with the move!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Sabina,
New house? Good!
I like my new chair. From shop. Good shop.
Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Sabina,
I hear you have a new apartment! That is good. I am happy for you.
I bought a table from a shop online. It was good and cheap, and the delivery was fast. You should look at it. It is called HomeStyle. Maybe you like it too, because you need things for your new apartment.
Bye!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Sabina,
I was so excited to hear about your new apartment! That's fantastic news. Moving can be stressful, though, so I wanted to share something that might help.
I recently bought some furniture online from a place called HomeStyle Furniture. I think their prices are pretty good, and the quality seems decent so far. Maybe you could check them out before you commit to buying everything elsewhere. It might save you some money.
Good luck with everything! Let me know if you need a hand with anything.
t11.sampleB2: Hey Sabina, Congrats on the new apartment – I'm so happy for you! Moving is a bit of a hassle, but it's such a fresh start. My advice? Don't rush to buy everything at once. I got most of my furniture from HomeStyle online – decent prices, and it turned up really fast. Definitely worth a look! Let me know if you need a hand. Take care, Dilnoza

Yaqinda men HomeStyle Furniture degan joydan onlayn mebel sotib oldim. O'ylashimcha, ularning narxlari juda yaxshi va sifati hozircha yaxshi ko'rinadi. Balki, boshqa joydan hamma narsani sotib olishga qaror qilishdan oldin ularni tekshirib ko'rarsan. Bu senga pulni tejashga yordam berishi mumkin.

Salom Sabina,
Yangi kvartira haqida eshitdim – tabriklayman! Bu juda katta qadam va men siz uchun juda xursandman. O'ylaymanki, siz bu joyni jihozlashga ancha vaqt sarflaysiz, shuning uchun yaqinda bo'lgan tajribamni baham ko'rmoqchiman.
Yaqinda men bo'sh xonamni jihozladim va mebellarning ko'p qismini HomeStyle Furniture deb nomlangan onlayn sotuvchidan sotib oldim. Men assortimentdan va, eng muhimi, narxlardan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Xullas, ko'chib o'tishingizga omad tilayman. Agar sizga qo'shimcha yordam kerak bo'lsa, xabar bering; men qo'limdan kelgancha yordam berishga tayyorman.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the furniture store. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear HomeStyle Customer Care, Thank you for contacting me about my recent furniture purchase. I am generally satisfied with my order. The sofa and coffee table look exactly like the online images, and the delivery team were punctual and professional. However, I experienced some issues with the assembly instructions. They were quite confusing and some parts were mislabeled, which made the process unnecessarily difficult. I would suggest providing clearer diagrams or even video tutorials. Additionally, I noticed a small scratch on one table leg upon delivery. While it's minor, I would appreciate knowing if replacement parts are available. For future improvements, I would love to see an augmented reality feature in your app to visualize furniture in my space before purchasing. Overall, I am happy with my purchase and would shop with you again. Yours sincerely, Sevara Salimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi HomeStyle!


I like my chair. It is blue.


The man came. He is nice.


Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hello!


I bought a table from you. It is okay. The delivery was good, and the men were nice. But the table has a small problem.


I want you to sell more chairs, and maybe lamps. My house needs lamps.


Thank you.
t12.sampleB1:
Dear HomeStyle Furniture,


Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my order. The delivery was on time, which was good. I also liked the sofa I bought; it looks nice in my living room.


However, the instructions for putting the bookshelf together were not very clear. I had some problems and it took me a long time. I think you should make them easier to understand.


Also, maybe you could sell more things for the garden? I would like to buy some garden furniture from you in the future.


Thank you for your time.


Sincerely,
Sevara Salimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear HomeStyle Customer Care, Thank you for getting in touch regarding my recent order. On the whole, I am delighted with my purchase and glad to share some feedback. The delivery went smoothly and even arrived ahead of schedule, and your team were both polite and efficient. The furniture itself matches the online images perfectly, so it certainly lived up to my expectations. That said, I did run into some difficulty with the assembly instructions, which were rather unclear in places. I would strongly recommend adding step-by-step diagrams or short video guides to make the process easier. As for your range, I would love to see more eco-friendly options and a wider choice of home office furniture, now that working from home is so common. Thank you for taking my comments on board. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Umuman olganda, men xaridimdan mamnunman va sizdan yana xarid qilaman.

Hurmat bilan,

Sevara Salimova
